pages.title: Musk Ox
pages.text: The musk ox ($(o)Ovibos moschatus$()) is a hoofed mammal of the Arctic, native to northern Canada and Greenland and reintroduced to parts of Alaska, Scandinavia and Siberia.$(br2)Despite its name and build, it is more closely related to sheep and goats than to cattle.$(br2)Its long outer coat covers a fine underwool called qiviut. When threatened, a herd forms a tight circle or line facing outward, horns towards the danger.
